entities.name: entomate_project
observations: Entomate is an AI-powered meeting intelligence platform
Tech stack: Node.js/Express backend, React frontend, Supabase database
Uses AI agents for task assignment, priority, deadline, and follow-up detection
Has automation engine with scheduling and retry logic
Production deployment uses Docker and AWS ECS Fargate

entities.name: agent_orchestration
observations: Use 5 specialized agents: ARCHITECT, BUILDER, QUALITY CHECKER, DEPLOYMENT SPECIALIST, LEARNING RECORDER
Switch agents mid-response based on task context
New Feature workflow: ARCHITECT -> BUILDER -> QUALITY -> DEPLOY -> LEARNING
Bug Fix workflow: QUALITY -> BUILDER -> QUALITY -> DEPLOY -> LEARNING
Database Change workflow: ARCHITECT -> BUILDER -> QUALITY -> BUILDER -> DEPLOY -> LEARNING

entities.name: architect_agent
observations: Use for high-level planning and structure decisions
Triggers: Starting new feature, refactoring, planning database changes
Output: Comprehensive technical plan with numbered steps
Creates implementation plans including: database changes, files to create/modify, services, UI components

entities.name: builder_agent
observations: Use for writing actual implementation code
Triggers: Building features, creating components, writing services
Output: Complete, ready-to-use code for specific files
Must match existing code patterns and include error handling

entities.name: quality_checker_agent
observations: Use for testing, debugging, and code review
Triggers: After writing code, encountering errors, before commits
Checks: TypeScript errors, error handling, bugs, performance, security, accessibility
Output: Specific issues found and how to fix them

entities.name: deployment_specialist_agent
observations: Use for Git workflow and deployment preparation
Triggers: Ready to deploy, CI/CD setup, environment variables
Output: Step-by-step terminal commands for git, push, verify
Includes pre/post deployment verification steps

entities.name: learning_recorder_agent
observations: Use for documenting patterns and building knowledge
Triggers: After solving difficult problems, discovering useful patterns, end of sessions
Output: Documentation with learnings, patterns to reuse, pitfalls to avoid
Updates knowledge base in CLAUDE.md or PATTERNS.md

entities.name: sql_migration_protocol
observations: PAUSE when SQL migrations are needed
Provide SQL script in copy/paste format
User runs SQL manually in Supabase dashboard
Continue with TypeScript type updates after confirmation
Include RLS policies and indexes in migrations

entities.name: code_patterns
observations: API routes: router + middleware + try/catch + proper responses
Services: class-based with async methods and error logging
React components: hooks for state, loading/error states, async data fetching
Always include proper error handling and logging
Use consistent naming conventions throughout

entities.name: context_preservation
observations: Always reference previous agent outputs in subsequent steps
Batch similar tasks together for efficiency
Maintain state between sessions using CLAUDE.md
Create session notes at end of development sessions
Document completed work in version control

entities.name: pre_deployment_checklist
observations: TypeScript builds without errors
No console.errors in code
Environment variables documented
Database migrations tested
RLS policies secure
Mobile responsive
Loading states present
Error handling complete

entities.name: week7_patterns
observations: Scheduled automation with node-cron in automationScheduler.js
3-step wizard UI for automation builder (AutomationBuilder.jsx)
Dry-run testing returns preview results without executing
Follow-up detection uses pattern matching + AI enhancement
Retry logic with exponential backoff for failed actions

entities.name: week8_patterns
observations: Rate limiting per endpoint type (auth=10/15min, AI=10/min, general=100/min)
Helmet security headers configuration
Winston structured logging with JSON format
Sentry error tracking integration
Docker multi-stage builds for smaller images
Artillery for load and smoke testing
Terraform for AWS ECS/Fargate infrastructure
